_comment: Maps a tool call to an Operation id, so the PreToolUse hook pulls that operation's lessons at the moment it fires. Copy to .neoize/triggers.json in your project and edit. 'contains' is matched case-insensitively against the serialised tool_input; null means any call to the tool. The operation ids are yours to name; author lessons against them with an anchor {type:'Operation', id:'<here>'}.
